messages:
julia_reed (customer): Hey @support — trying to redeem a trial promo via the API, getting a 410/GONE with body { \"error\": \"promo_expired\" }. Dashboard (partner portal) shows the code as available. Can you help?

julia_reed (customer): curl I used:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"code":"SPARK-TRIAL-50","org_id":"org_98XY"}'
```

alice_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact code (no formatting) and the account email/org? Also any request id from the API response? :wave:

julia_reed (customer): Code exactly: SPARK-TRIAL-50
Org: org_98XY
Email: julia@acmestarts.com
API response (full): {"error":"promo_invalid","reason":"expired_or_deactivated","request_id":"req_01GJZ7"}

alice_support: Got it. I'm checking the promo backend now. quick note: sometimes copy/paste from PDFs or partner portals adds weird unicode (ZWSP/nbspace) which our normalizer previously cleaned differently for partner-dispatched codes. Running lookup...

alice_support: @mike_billing /billing — this looks like a partner-scoped promo. The ledger shows the code in partner namespace and status=deactivated as of 2026-03-14 23:59:59 UTC, but the partner portal is caching availability (stale). Can billing confirm if this was intentionally deactivated?

mike_billing: Looking. Partner (ACME channel) CSV shows code was scheduled to expire 2026-03-14. I see a recent org merge for org_98XY on 2026-03-15 which may have affected scope mapping.

alice_support: Julia — can you confirm how you received the code? Direct email from partner or via an invite link?

julia_reed (customer): Received in a promo email from ACME partner last night. I copied directly from the email.

deepak_eng: Jumping in — tagging logs with req_01GJZ7. Looking at redemption trace: promo_id=pr_7c3, incoming_code_bytes show an extra 0xC2 0xA0 (NBSP) after the second dash. Our lookup pipeline treats NBSP as not-matching so the normalization path fell back to the partner-scope lookup which returned status deactivated.

deepak_eng: Repro steps locally: redeeming literal string with NBSP returns same 410. If you copy/paste SPARK-TRIAL-50 into a hex-inspector you can spot it (looks like two dashes).

julia_reed (customer): Oh no — that was probably from the HTML email. I can try retyping, but the curl above used what I pasted.

alice_support: Two immediate options:
1) We can issue a manual trial credit to your account now (temporary fix).
2) Engineering will normalize partner codes more aggressively (strip NBSP/em-dash variants) and verify partner-portal cache invalidation.
Which would you prefer?

julia_reed (customer): Manual credit please — we need this to hit today for a customer demo. Thanks!

mike_billing: Issuing manual credit: granting 50 trial credits to julia@acmestarts.com on org_98XY, note FIN-CR-9021. Will follow up if anything else required.

sre-bot: [deploy] Started rollout of normalizer hotfix to staging (ENG-5821).

deepak_eng: Filed ENG-5821: partner-code normalization + cache invalidation for partner dashboard. Fix will: strip common invisible whitespace (NBSP, ZWSP), normalize em-dash to hyphen, and add logging to detect future malformed copies. Will push hotfix to prod after quick canary.

alice_support: Manual credit is in place. Julia, can you confirm you see the +50 trial on your billing page?

julia_reed (customer): Confirmed — I see 50 trial credits applied. Thanks so much for the quick turnaround! :raised_hands:

alice_support: Thanks for the patience. We'll keep ENG-5821 open until we verify the normalization rollout and partner-portal cache is invalidated. Closing support thread after follow-up. :white_check_mark:
